name: BESTLIFE2030 grants for biodiversity in EU Overseas
summary: EU-funded grants, coordinated by IUCN, for locally led projects that conserve and restore biodiversity in the EU's outermost regions and Overseas Countries and Territories, run as regional calls for proposals.

geography.label: EU outermost regions (ORs) and Overseas Countries and Territories (OCTs)

reporting: Projects track results against a logframe with SMART indicators and must contribute to at least one of the programme's mandatory biodiversity indicators.

status.quote: The 3rd call for proposals is now open!

deadline.quote: Concept notes must be submitted by 8 December 2026 at 14:00 CET.

status.quote: With two calls now completed and two additional calls planned, BESTLIFE2030 is progressing steadily towards full implementation of its €23.4 million budget.

pool.quote: its overall €23.4 million budget, expected to support approximately 234 projects across four calls.

administered_by.quote: the IUCN EU Representative Office, as coordinator, working alongside the following organizations to execute the BESTLIFE2030 project

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations, local non-governmental organisations (NGOs); • Local civil society organisations (CSOs); • Local community-based organisations (CBOs); • SMEs as defined by the European Commission2; • Local research institutes and organisations (provided eligible activities are implemented); • Local sub-governmental bodies, e.g. municipalities and groups thereof;

geography.quote: is a granting mechanism focusing on preserving and restoring biodiversity in the EU's outermost regions (ORs) and Overseas Countries and Territories (OCTs)

access.quote: Applications are managed through the IUCN Grant Management System and may be submitted in English or French.

window.quote: expected to support approximately 234 projects across four calls.

amount.quote: BESTLIFE2030 grants amount to a maximum of EUR 100,000 per recipient.

co_finance_required.quote: Co-funding must cover at least 5% of the total budget.

reporting.quote: All projects MUST contribute to at least ONE indicator from the 'Biodiversity' category.
